text:
(1) Any person who without just excuse—
(a) disobeys a witness summons requiring him to attend before the
Crown Court; or
(b) disobeys a requirement made by the Crown Court under section 51B,
shall be guilty of contempt of that court and may be punished summarily by
that court as if his contempt were in the face of the court.

(2) A person shall not be committed to prison by reason of any disobedience
mentioned in subsection (1) for a period exceeding three months.
